name: alpaca-connectors-153
description: Agent-ready project card for the Alpaca Connectors repository. This project supports strict Alpaca asset registration, ETF holdings-category orchestration, Alpaca stock-bar planning and updates, and a thin FastAPI support surface over those existing workflows.

skills.name: API Surfaces
skills.description: Support the repository's existing FastAPI surface for discovery, registration, holdings-category execution, and lightweight OHLC chart responses.
examples: Update the single-ticker registration API response without changing the underlying registration logic.

skills.name: Asset Registration
skills.description: Use the supported CLI and reusable modules to plan or execute strict Alpaca plus OpenFIGI-backed Main Sequence asset registration.
examples: Register NVDA and AAPL through the supported asset registration flow.

skills.name: Holdings Category
skills.description: Plan or execute holdings-backed Main Sequence asset-category sync from ETF constituents using the supported project workflow.
examples: Create or refresh HOLDINGS__IVV after confirming all extracted holdings are registered.

skills.name: Stock Bars
skills.description: Plan or execute Alpaca stock-bar updates for one asset, a ticker list, or a holdings category through the supported CLI and DataNode modules.
examples: Plan a daily IVV stock-bar update without running the node.
